ov: Short-legged, muscular marsupials of Australia that dig large burrows with rodent-like front teeth and powerful claws. Their pouch faces backwards, so no soil gets in while they dig.

why.ac: Mainly crepuscular and nocturnal, though wombats come out on cool or overcast days too.

df: Grasses, sedges, herbs, bark and roots.

cf.tip: The koala is the wombat’s closest living relative, but it lives in trees and eats eucalyptus leaves.

fx: When attacked, a wombat dives into its tunnel and blocks it with its tough rump.
